Krishna reveals his identity as Time, the destroyer of worlds, and declares that all warriors except Arjuna will be destroyed.
Krishna commands Arjuna to fight, stating that Drona, Bhishma, Jayadratha, Karna, and other warriors are already slain by him, and Arjuna should merely be the instrument.

Arjuna, trembling and fearful, bows to Krishna with folded hands and praises him as the supreme deity, greater than Brahma, the wind god, Yama, Varuna, fire god, moon god, Prajapati, and the ancient ancestor.
Arjuna apologizes to Krishna for disrespecting him by calling him 'Black Prince! Yadava! Friend!' out of negligence or affection, not knowing his greatness.
